caption: The taut skin of a tambourine is struck, and the skin shivers and the metal jingles rattle before quieting.

sa.check: A tambourine with a skin and metal jingles.
The skin shivers and the jingles rattle.
The tambourine quiets: skin and jingles are still.
The strike lands on the skin, not on the rim.
The strike comes first; the shiver and rattle follow, then the quiet.

pc.expect: The skin is still and the jingles hang at rest until the hand lands on the skin; both begin moving at the strike and only then.
pc.fail: The jingles are already rattling before the hand reaches the skin; or the skin trembles while the hand is well away; or the hand strikes and neither skin nor jingles move; or the jingles start rattling again after quieting while the tambourine is held still and nothing strikes it.

pc.expect: The skin's shiver and the jingles' rattle are strongest right after the strike and fade together until both are still.
pc.fail: The rattle grows after the strike; or the jingles keep rattling unchanged for the whole clip; or the jingles stop dead in mid-rattle.

pc.expect: The skin flexes as a stretched membrane and springs back flat; the frame stays rigid and the jingles stay on their pins.
pc.fail: The hand's print stays pressed into the skin; or the frame bends or wobbles like rubber; or a jingle bends or folds; or the skin sags loose.

pc.expect: The jingles move only within their slots, pivoting on their pins, and settle hanging or lying in place.
pc.fail: A jingle slides along the frame to another slot; or spins free of its pin while staying in the frame; or a jingle stays frozen while its partner on the same pin rattles.

pc.expect: One tambourine with its skin, frame and the same jingles; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The hand passes through the skin; or jingles appear or vanish from the frame; or the skin vanishes leaving an open ring; or the tambourine changes into another object.

pc.expect: The skin's colour, the frame's finish and the jingles' shine stay the same.
pc.fail: The skin changes colour or gains a pattern; or the frame changes colour; or the jingles change colour or size.

note: The tambourine may be held; small movements of the holding hand are not judged as strikes. Sound is not judged.
